primary_discovery_pass: Host catalog contains the exact enabled target; no personal/project/plugin contamination
Prompt contains no target name, explicit skill invocation or request to search for skills
A successful observable read of the target SKILL.md, or host skill-use event, occurs before the relevant method decision
Actual search for a reusable external skill/workflow and actual source/resource/license inspection
A suitable method is actually applied to the task and its output independently checked
go_rule: GO for a limited Codex preview requires intact legal/package checks, both explicit smokes and one valid implicit full-chain pilot. Broad reliability or performance claims require the independent friend study; no paired result is prefilled. Otherwise NO-GO for that unsupported claim, with precise blockers.
limits: CLI token usage is reported, not a hard token/dollar cap. Wall/tool caps are equal. A local author pilot is not a friend's A/B result or a desktop activation test. A folder is not an OS security boundary. Use separate disposable containers/VMs for the friend study.
additional_adopted_review_gate: Actual source/method and applicable license-body inspection for each newly adopted substantive workflow/tool/resource, with version and use-scope decision
Search snippets, SPDX-only metadata or download/save alone do not establish inspection
Review evidence must precede adoption/use; fallback and added resources reopen their corresponding gate; no backdating
